propositions: The gate matches field names globally against any same-named attribute anywhere in src/rebar, so a field whose name is reused on an unrelated config passes the gate even if never read on its own class.

Four fields are newly flagged when the gate is fixed to resolve reads to owning dataclass rather than bare attribute names: McpConfig.readonly, McpConfig.allow_llm, McpConfig.allow_jira_sync, and JiraConfig.allow_insecure.
Each newly-flagged field is live and consumed through a real reader path (inside excluded plumbing files or via string keys), requiring factual read-via markers rather than product triage.
Test fixtures must be migrated from bare-name membership contract to owner-resolution contract, including inversion of test_unrelated_same_named_attribute_keeps_the_gate_quiet to expect a firing.
Existing negative fixtures (ReconcilerConfig.lock_lease_secs, VerifyConfig requirement fields) must remain passing via their pre-existing read-via markers.
